title: Report rejected occupied-slot loads in Title and Journal with usable retry

environment.input: native X11 key events (xdotool) into the real game window

fixture.seed: docs/qa/issue-83-load-failure/tools/seed_fixture.gd writes one real campaign through Campaign.save_to_slot(2); slots 0/1 are then written by the shell.

slot_1.content: valid JSON envelope, invalid campaign types (flags is an array)

slot_2.content: real valid campaign written by production code

steps.step: Title Load lists all three occupied slots, including both invalid files
steps.observed: Load Game shows 'Slot 0 — (Classic)', 'Slot 1 — (Classic)', 'Slot 2 — mock_battle (Classic)', Back; Slot 0 selected.

steps.step: Title rejects the malformed occupied slot 0
steps.observed: Top-wide band: 'Slot 0 couldn't be loaded — choose another slot.' Load menu stays open and selected; no scene change.

steps.step: Retry on the same rejected slot
steps.observed: Identical frame (same SHA-256 as the first rejection): the band persists and the menu stays usable; slot_0.json bytes unchanged.

steps.step: Title rejects a valid-JSON slot with invalid campaign types
steps.observed: Band: 'Slot 1 couldn't be loaded — choose another slot.' Menu still open; no scene change.

steps.step: Cancel returns to the main menu with the feedback cleared
steps.observed: Main menu (New Game / Load Game / Dev Jump / Quit) with no stale band.

steps.step: Choosing an existing valid slot still continues normally
steps.observed: Slot 2 loads and the campaign continues into the campus ('Week 3 — Study week', Kai at the fountain).

steps.step: Journal System rejects the occupied invalid slot 1
steps.input: J, Right x4 (System), Down x3, Enter
steps.observed: Existing toast: 'Slot 1 couldn't be loaded — choose another slot.' System tab, book and Load row stay open; no scene change.

steps.step: Journal rejects the next invalid slot with its own one-based numbering
steps.observed: Toast: 'Slot 2 couldn't be loaded — choose another slot.' Book still open.

steps.step: Changing tab clears a stale load rejection
Repaired slot retried from Journal takes the existing success route
steps.input: copy valid campaign over slot_0.json, Left, Up, Enter
steps.observed: Load — Slot 1 loads the campaign and continues into the campus; no toast.

steps.step: Compact 640x360: Title rejects an invalid occupied slot
steps.observed: Band reads 'Slot 1 couldn't be loaded — choose another slot.' fully inside the 640x360 client; menu usable.

steps.step: Compact 640x360: Journal rejects an invalid occupied slot
steps.input: J, Right x4, Down x4, Enter
steps.observed: Toast reads 'Slot 2 couldn't be loaded — choose another slot.' Book stays open; the message is fully legible (it sits over the last System rows, which is the pre-existing toast placement at this size).

default_run.verdict: slot_0 changed only because the operator deliberately overwrote it with the valid campaign for the retry step; the rejected slot_1 and the loaded slot_2 are byte-identical.

retry_run.verdict: all three files byte-identical after a rejected load and an immediate retry.

limits: No full-school replay and no Neal taste/visual approval is claimed; this is bounded rejection/retry evidence.
At 640x360 the Journal toast uses the existing toast rectangle and therefore sits over the last System rows; the load rows and the message stay legible. That placement is unchanged by this issue.
The ornate nine-patch corner artifacts visible on the Journal frame at compact sizes are pre-existing and not introduced here.

The Title status band was changed from the nine-patch to the Journal toast's plain navy fill + gold rule after the first real-window capture showed the ornament cutting through the message at 34 px height.
